_note: Yfory, the playable game. Placeholders in braces are filled by the UI. Plural keys have one and other forms. Plain words: docs/design/plain-wales.md.
title: Play
hook.line: This is Wales in 2026. In 2050 a young person will write to you about what you did.
hook.touch: Point at a place you know. Every figure here is real.
bar.caretaker: You are out of office this turn
bar.atlas: Look it up in the atlas
opening.no_new_trend: No new slow change this turn.
opening.returning: You are back in office. Trust is low. You have 1 coin less this turn.
slip.from: A slow change is under way
slip.peek_note: See next turn’s slow change now. You can do this once a turn.
slip.peeked_none: Next turn: no new slow change.
slip.shock_form: This can turn into a crisis: {name}
pledge.ask: People ask you for one promise this turn.
pledge.declined: You made no promise this turn.
pledge.note: Keep it and Trust goes up. If {strand} falls, Trust falls further.
plan.limit.one: Trust lets you play 1 card this turn
plan.limit.other: Trust lets you play {n} cards this turn
plan.contingency_none: No coins saved for a crisis
plan.budget_carried_hit: Taken by last turn's crisis (not your saved coins)
plan.choose_region: Choose a region on the map or below.
plan.compact_both: Both regions working together (1 coin more)
plan.visit_card: If you play it there, {place} may ask you to visit.
plan.cannot_limit: Trust lets you play no more cards this turn.
plan.cannot_budget: Not enough coins left this turn.
plan.commit_note: Coins you do not spend or save are lost. Save up to 2 for a crisis. If none comes, they carry over.
plan.nothing_played: You have not played a card. Wales gets a little worse on its own every turn. Play at least one.
plan.ghost_plan: With the cards you have chosen
plan.ghost_fuzzy: but it could be 1 point either way
plan.ghost_after: Works after 2050. Too late for your years. It still counts in Left for 2050.
plan.ghost_none: No goal moves enough to see
plan.keys: Arrow keys move through your cards. Enter opens one. P plays it.
plan.problem.wrong_step: You can only play cards in step 1.
plan.problem.not_in_hand: That card is not in your hand.
plan.problem.duplicate: You have already played that card this turn.
plan.problem.over_limit: Trust lets you play no more cards this turn.
plan.problem.over_budget: Not enough coins left this turn.
plan.problem.compact_not_in_force: Those regions are not working together yet.
plan.problem.debt_max: You already have the most loans you can take.
plan.problem.no_debt: You have no loan to pay back.
plan.problem.hold_over_invalid: You can only keep a card you have not played.
plan.problem.upkeep_unknown: That running cost is not due.
ledger.title: Borrowing and bills
ledger.standing_note: These do not use a card slot. You can use one each turn.
ledger.repay_cancel: Do not pay it back this turn
ledger.upkeep_skipped: Not paid: it starts to fail.
ledger.no_upkeep: No running costs due this turn.
post.label: On its way
post.after: Works after 2050. It still counts for the people who come after you.
timeline.label: 2026 to 2050: 6 turns of 4 years
region.highlight: The four regions are lit up on the map.
visit.why: {card} is being built there now. Your choices there decide how well it works.
visit.stay_note: If you stay away, the card still works. But you do not get to choose how.
passing.title: {from} to {to}
passing.quiet: No crisis this turn. Four years pass quietly.
shock.label: A crisis hits
shock.respond2: Spend 2 coins: cut it to a quarter
shock.ready_by: {cards} softened the blow before you spent anything.
shock.explain: Do nothing and it hits in full. 1 coin halves the damage. 2 coins cut it to a quarter.
shock.contingency.one: You saved 1 coin for a crisis.
shock.contingency.other: You saved {n} coins for a crisis.
shock.contingency_none: You saved no coins for a crisis.
shock.fragile: Repairs you put off make this hit harder.
changed.title: What happened, {from} to {to}
changed.stock_down: {cause} used up some of what {strand} leaves for 2050.
changed.no_slips: Nothing changed enough to see this turn.
cause.baseline: Things that get worse on their own
event.R12: A coal tip moving in a storm
event.R20: A Welsh-speaking area falling below half Welsh speakers
trace.title: Why did this change?
trace.strand_line: {strand} went from {from} to {to} out of 10. This is one of the reasons.
trace.sharp: Most of the futures we tried agree on this.
trace.fuzzy: This could be 1 point higher or lower.
trace.placeholder: A rough rule for now. It waits for better evidence.
trace.game_rule: A rule of the game, not a fact about Wales.
trace.no_rule: This comes straight from the card itself.
trace.ending: This is a rough guide for all of Wales, not a count of homes or people.
trace.none: No single cause is big enough to show here.
trust.label: Trust: {band}
trust.reason.promise_kept: Your cards arrived when you said they would.
trust.reason.gap_narrowed: The poorest places caught up a little.
trust.reason.gap_widened: The poorest places fell further behind.
trust.reason.shock_prepared: You were ready for the crisis.
trust.reason.shock_responded: You spent your emergency fund on the crisis.
trust.reason.debt_interest: Paying for loans is starting to show.
trust.reason.nothing_visible: Nothing happened that people could see.
trust.reason.drift: Trust drifted back towards the middle.
trust.reason.curveball: A slow change made life harder.
trust.reason.card: {detail} was unpopular where it was built.
trust.reason.shadow_pledge: You kept your promise while out of office.
election.title: The election, {year}
election.lost: You lost the election. A stand-in runs Wales for 4 years.
election.band: Trust at the end of this turn: {band}.
caretaker.title: You are out of office this turn
caretaker.body: You lost the election. A stand-in runs Wales for 4 years and plays the two cheapest cards. You can still make one promise. Keep it and you come back stronger.
caretaker.shadow_note: If that goal does not fall, you come back with a little more Trust.
voice.label: A made-up voice, to show how it might feel
onboard.hand: These are your cards. Point at one to see what it would change.
onboard.ticket: The left side shows the cost in coins. The right side shows when it starts to work.
onboard.play: Open a card. Then play it, or choose where it goes.
onboard.post: It is on its way. It shows on the timeline when it starts to work.
onboard.commit: Coins you do not spend or save are lost. Save up to 2 for a crisis. If none comes, they carry over.
onboard.strands: The bar shows life today. The small 2050 marker shows what is left for later.
onboard.pull: Press Why? on anything that changed.
onboard.trust: Trust sets how many cards you can play next turn.
onboard.region: This card needs a region. The map lights up the four.
map.failed: The map data did not load. Check your connection, then try again.
map.label: Paper relief map of Wales
save.load_failed: That saved game could not be read. A new game has started.
save.shared: You are looking at someone else’s game.
error.model: The rules of the game did not load. Check your connection, then try again.
error.engine: The game could not take that step. Try again, or start a new game.
end.lived_note: How people got on while you ran Wales
end.lower: Your result is the weaker of the two: {which}, {band}. Spending the future to look good now does not win.
end.fuzzy_edge: Your result could be one level either side: {low} to {high}.
end.ghost_note: On autopilot, the same Wales ends up: {band}.
end.worst_note: The worst turn counts extra in Life in your years.
end.prompt.lived_lower: Life in your years was the weaker side. Which quick card would have given you room for slow ones?
end.prompt.left_lower: People in 2050 paid for your years. Which slow card would you play sooner?
end.prompt.weakest: {strand} did worst. What would have helped it?
end.prompt.debts: You left loans unpaid. What did they buy? Was it worth it?
end.prompt.no_well: No visit went well. Go to {place} again and choose differently.
end.prompt.lost_seat: You lost the election in {year}. What used up the Trust?
end.prompt.neglect: {region} got nothing for too long. Would one card there have changed the letter?
end.prompt.contingency: Crises hit in full. Would saving 1 coin for a crisis have helped?
end.weights: Change how much each goal counts
end.weights_note: Weights change how much each goal counts in your score. They are shown with every result.
end.share: Copy the link to this game
end.again_note: A new game: different cards and events.
strand_aria: {strand}, {n} out of 10. {sharp}. Left for 2050: {stock} out of 10.
foot.honesty: A thinking tool, not a forecast.
foot.attrib: Boundaries ONS (OGL). Terrain AWS Terrain Tiles. Places: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), BGS (OGL), NRW, WIMD.
plan.ghost_up: This card would push it up
plan.ghost_down: This card would pull it down
plan.ghost_row_plan: With the cards you have chosen
end.range_up: With the same choices, luck could have put you anywhere from about {a} to {b} points up.
end.range_down: With the same choices, luck could have put you anywhere from about {a} to {b} points down.
end.range_mixed: With the same choices, luck could have put you anywhere from about {a} points down to {b} up.
end.vs_ahead.one: You finished about 1 point ahead of autopilot.
end.vs_ahead.other: You finished about {n} points ahead of autopilot.
end.vs_behind.one: You finished about 1 point behind autopilot.
end.vs_behind.other: You finished about {n} points behind autopilot.
end.unit: Change since 2026, across the seven goals.
end.terms_note: Each turn against 2026. The first turn is what you started with, so it does not count.
end.dipped: One of your turns fell below 2026. It counts extra in Life in your years.
plan.tray_hint: Choose a card to open it and play it.
plan.partners_note: Needs local help: half as strong unless regions are working together there, or your visit goes well.
plan.after_2050: Works after 2050. Too late for your years. It still counts in Left for 2050.
trace.fuzzy_word: it could be 1 point either way
sharpkey.line: “About” means we are fairly sure. “Probably” means it could be 1 point either way.
end.prompt.no_visit: You never visited a place. Next time, go to the Rhondda or Bethesda when they ask.
slip.peek_answers: Cards in your hand that help: {cards}
slip.peek_none_in_hand: No card in your hand helps with it yet.
plan.ghost_if_plan: With the cards you have chosen:
plan.upkeep_note: Once built, it has a running cost: {pips} every {terms}.
plan.upkeep_note_each: Once built, it has a running cost: {pips} every turn.
map.rings: Your cards so far: each ring is a card at work.
changed.ripple: The building work for {cause} gave {strand} a short lift.
changed.response_spent.one: You spent 1 coin: {share} of the damage hit.
changed.response_spent.other: You spent {n} coins: {share} of the damage hit.
changed.response_none: You spent nothing: all of the damage hit.

changed.response_landed: In the end, {share} of the full damage hit.
plan.staged: First effects in {first}. The rest in {full}.
opening.first_effects: {card} starts to work now. The rest comes in {year}.
opening.in_full: now working in full. It started in {year}
changed.held_down: {strand} held level. It was pulled down a little by {cause}, but other things held it up.
changed.held_up: {strand} held level. It got a small push up from {cause}, too small to show.

end.prompt.left_fine: Left for 2050 came out {change}. Which slow card would you play 4 years sooner?
end.weakest_term: Life was lowest in {year}, but never below 2026
trace.strand_same.one: {strand} stayed at {to} out of 10. This reason pulled against the others.
trace.strand_same.other: {strand} stayed at {to} out of 10. This reason pulled against the others.
visit.why_one: You played {card}. It is being built there now. Go and choose how it is done. Good choices make the card work better.
visit.why_many: You played {card}. They are being built there now. Go and choose how. Good choices make them work better.
visit.why_trend: {trend} is hitting the valley this turn. Your choices there decide how well it copes.
visit.choose: Two places ask you to visit. You can go to one this turn.
changed.recovery_card: {strand}: the short dip from {cause} is over.
visit.choose_note: Wherever you go, your choices there decide how well your cards work.
